title: Festival of Lights Berlin 2026 - Quick Summary
items: **October 9–18, 2026 · Colours of Love.** The programme lists 37 illuminated locations.
**Outdoor light walk: free, normally 19:00–23:00.** Individual dates and hours can vary.
**Central route:** Alexanderplatz → Nikolai Quarter → Berlin Cathedral → Bebelplatz → Brandenburg Gate → Potsdamer Platz. Allow 2 to 2.5 hours.
**Wait for a complete show:** Rathausstraße 17 about 4 minutes, Dom 6, Hotel de Rome & Behren Palais 12, Gate 10.
**Date exceptions:** Konzerthaus skips October 11; the park at Rathaus Lichtenberg is October 9 only.
**Dom inside needs a separate ticket:** Beyond the Light October 9–11 (€28); In Concert October 13–17 (from €58). Check your exact slot.
